faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the ProBook 450 G5, 455 G5 and 470 G5 specifically. It does not fit the older G3/G4 or newer G6/G7 versions — those use a different keyboard. Send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp if you're unsure.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this is the non-backlit version. We also stock the backlit version for the same series.
